Messages.Author: Robert Goudie
Messages.Body:
So I have been talking to Billy Baldwin about V:TES for 6 months or
so. When we discussed the predator / prey mechanic he says that the
mechanic exists in a game called Quintet which is based on a board
game found in the Robert Altman movie of the same name. In Robert
Altman's book "Altman on Altman" he explains that players may only
capture the piece clockwise in the order (which is basically a circle
of 5 tokens).

I've never played Quintet but I want to check out the rules now out of
curiosity.

-Robert
